senses.gloss: m. (שבך; cmp. שְׂבָכָה) net-work, esp. (b. h. אֲרֻבָּה) dove-cote.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 40:4">Ex. R. s. 40</cite> (play on <he>ש̇ו̇ב̇ל̇</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:1">I Chr. IV, 1</cite>, sq.) <he>ושובל שהעמיד ש̇וב̇ך̇ לאֹלהים</he> (not <he>ושובך</he>) Bezalel was surnamed Shobal because he erected a dove-cote for God, <he>זה המשכן שהיה עומד כש׳</he> that is the Tabernacle, which stood (high) like a dove-cote.
<cite ref="I Chronicles 4:1">Ib.</cite> <he>העמיד … כש׳</he> the Lord had the Tabernacle put up like a dove-cote (for the dove Israel).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:5">B. Bath. II, 5</cite> <he>מרחיקין … מן הש׳ וכ׳</he> you must keep your ladder (when lopping trees &c.) four cubits away from your neighbor’s dove-cote.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מרחיקין את הש׳ וֹכ׳</he> you must keep your dove-cotes at a distance of fifty cubits from the town. Ib. 6 <he>הרי הוא של בעל הש׳</he> it belongs to the owner of the nearest dove-cote. Ib. V, 3 <he>פירות ש׳</he> the crop of a dove-cote (the brood of the season); a. fr.—Pl. <he>שׁוֹבָכוֹת</he>, <he>שׁוֹבָכִין</he>. Ib. II, 6.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 83a:11">B. Kam. 83ᵃ</cite> <he>ישוב ש׳</he> a group of dove-cotes; a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 4:7">Pes. IV, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 55b:5">55ᵇ</cite>) <he>מושיבין ש׳ לתרנגולים וכ׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>לתרנגולת</he>) you may set up chicken-houses (put in eggs for brooding) on the fourteenth of Nisan; [vers. quoted in Rashi: <he>מושיבין ש׳ ותרנגולת</he> you may set brooding doves in cotes, and also hens].
